# Romance Dawn

[All quest chapters](index.md)

## Romance Dawn

Gol D. Roger died laughing, and his last words sent the whole world to sea. Wealth, fame and power are out there for anyone bold enough to chase them.

Open the character creator and decide who you are: your race, your faction and your fighting style. Every chapter of this book follows from those three choices.

**Tasks**

- Choose a race, a faction and a fighting style

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +3,000, Rookie Crate, 5 XP levels

<a id="q-567d7bebe6d3322d"></a>

## A Dream on the Horizon

A crew needs more than fighters. Sanji cooks, Franky builds, Nami charts the seas. On this server every sailor may learn two professions.

Choose at least one profession. Each one has its own chapter under Professions.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Choose a profession

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000

<a id="q-60dd5769925d8832"></a>

## Set Sail

Luffy left Foosha Village in a barrel-sized boat and nearly drowned before lunch. You can do better.

Get a boat and land on three different islands. Your Log Pose records every island you set foot on.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Land on 3 different islands

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +3,000

<a id="q-64be235ea40196fc"></a>

## The Log Pose Remembers

Every island has its own magnetic signature, and every island has its own troubles.

Open your Log Pose on any island and collect all three of its local missions. Three collected missions also unlock fast travel from that island.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Set Sail](01_romance_dawn.md#q-60dd5769925d8832)

**Tasks**

- Complete the Log Pose missions of 1 island

**Rewards**

- Doriki +150, Belly +3,000

<a id="q-2dbb2fe4218fd7e4"></a>

## A Crew Worth Sailing With

**Optional quest.**

Zoro was tied to a post in Shells Town when Luffy asked him to join. Crews start in strange places.

Create a crew with /crew create &lt;name&gt; or accept an invitation. Crews share island conquest scores and make the server-wide events far easier.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Belong to a crew

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +5,000

<a id="q-7463e6140079a242"></a>

## Mountain Bandits

The bandits who laughed at Shanks in the Party's Bar got exactly what they deserved.

Defeat ten bandits of any rank. Bandit camps and forts dot the islands of every Blue.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 10 bandits

**Rewards**

- Doriki +150, Belly +4,000

<a id="q-7c510d231eb03ae8"></a>

## Higuma the Bear

Higuma the mountain bandit took Luffy hostage and fed him to the Lord of the Coast. Shanks lost an arm saving him.

Take the Higuma challenge from the Challenges menu and win.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Mountain Bandits](01_romance_dawn.md#q-7463e6140079a242)

**Tasks**

- Defeat Higuma

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +5,000
